notesForUsage: The `scripted` profile, on its own, for the end-to-end tier.
`llm.json` at the repository root is gitignored and holds whatever model the developer is
actually using — a local one, a paid one, whatever `just setup` left plus their edits. The
mail journey must not depend on that choice: it asserts that a Document born from a mail
triggers the Receptionist exactly as a typed one does, and a model that emits its tool calls
as prose would fail that assertion for a reason that has nothing to do with the letterbox.
So `tests/flow/0-mail-arrives.spec.ts` recreates the Runtime container with LLM_CONFIG_FILE
pointing here, and puts it back afterwards. `scripted` is a recorded substitute for a paid,
non-deterministic third party, not a mock of anything this repository owns — see
runtime/src/llm/scripted.ts — and the script it replays is the same one the compose default
uses, runtime/fixtures/llm-script.json, mounted in the image at /run/fixtures.
There is no `vision` profile here on purpose: an absent one is the shipped default and not an
error, and nothing in this journey reads a scan.
